first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, so simplifying onboarding addresses the clearest shared funnel constraint and can improve qualified revenue without immediately discounting customers. Verify the prior onboarding result before acting, and guard against lower-quality or less-qualified signups by measuring first meaningful action, retained activation, and qualified pipeline—not completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding, prioritizing the strongest direct response to the 4% completion decline and likely contributor to the 6% activation decline. The verified prior result showed completion +13%, time-to-value reduced by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, supporting sustainable qualified revenue rather than relying on discounts. Measure activation, first meaningful action, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue to ensure improved completion does not reduce lead quality.
